question: How do dissolution and phoneme arising relate to the paths of time?
premises: Variety of dissolution and arising of phonemes are treated.
They occur in the conception of the path of time.
They occur in the arising of the wheel divided into mantra and vidyā wheels.
inference: Temporal structure and mantra-vidyā wheels frame the play of dissolution and phoneme arising.
uncertainties: The parsing of cakrabhinmantravidyābhi follows the compound as transmitted.
plain_english: The variety of dissolution and the arising of phonemes occur in the conception of the path of time and in the arising of that wheel divided into the wheels of mantra and vidyā.
